rulings: Ruling: Task 5 keeps every existing flow.md section (Tasks, Rulings, Deviations, Plan review) while converting to the new format, and the controller writes flow.md only between tasks — the plan has both writers — costs a merge by hand if a line lands mid-task.

Ruling: the brief clause and Global Constraints are delivered verbatim in `rules.md` in this workspace, which every implementer and reviewer prompt names as its first read, instead of pasting them into each prompt — same text, one copy — costs a subagent that skips the file (reviewers check the clause was applied).

Ruling: Task 9 Step 5's "ask Claude to add a view" runs as `claude -p` with `--plugin-dir` in the worktree — no interactive session from here — costs not seeing the live reload by eye; the user sees it at the slice checkpoint.

Ruling: ts-rs 12 writes type-only `.ts` bindings, not `.d.ts` — accepted as the "generated .d.ts" of Global Constraints, since `--print-types` (Task 6) concatenates them into one declaration file — costs a rename step there if tsc objects.

Ruling: copied real fixtures under crates/flow-cockpit/core/tests/fixtures/docs/ are excluded from treefmt and the flake `vendored` list (both files already in Task 2's list) — a fixture prettier rewrites no longer tests the real shape (it already unindented the ledger's wrapped line) — costs those fixtures staying unformatted.

Ruling: a user entry opens a turn only when it is not `isMeta` and its text (a string, or the text blocks of an array) doesn't start with `<` — the brief's rule read literally turns real meta entries into prompts (20 of 54 in this project) and drops image prompts, while the spec groups turns by the user's prompts — costs a fix round on Task 3.
Ruling: status precedence Done > Waiting > Working > Stale > Idle — the spec lists Waiting first and a run waiting on the user stays theirs to act on — costs a 4-day-old wait never reading Stale.

Ruling: Config::parse/load (Result<_, String>), Default on LinkCache and LinkCache::bytes_read() are implied by the brief (Config from config.toml; the 2 MB test measures bytes), not deviations — none crosses to the views — costs three public items the plan didn't name.
Ruling: core/tests/index.rs (not on the Files list) accepted — same as docs.rs and activity.rs in Tasks 2-3 — costs nothing.

Ruling: the 1 MiB whole-head cap and `rebuild_project` listing dirs from the old roots enter the fix round — both make a session vanish, against spec:29 ("any Claude session's activity can be found") — costs a larger fix round. Folders matching no root wait for Task 6 (call `build` when a new folder appears in claude_projects).
Ruling: design/docs.json (raw docs for the Docs tab) is part of "its JSON" in the listed design folder — costs nothing.
Task 2: finding (from Task 5): parse_ledger glues `Ruling:` and `Note` lines into the task entry above them instead of `rulings` — fix after the Task 5 stop.
